configuration.simulation: single.sim (8 to 12 um, 400 x 400, one capture)
configuration.form: pass-through (manifold.engines.dirsig.passthrough.run_engine on a copy of the demo archive's folder)
configuration.changed_from_demo: the .tasks reference datetime only (single.tasks); the demo's own offset is -05:00

method: d2.py: Balfour2.zip from the installation extracted outside the repository; per render a fresh copy of the folder with only the reference datetime of single.tasks rewritten (the same instant at -05:00, +00:00 and +09:00, the clock time adjusted; the +09:00 clock falls on the next day), then the SDK's pass-through runner (scene2hdf, then dirsig5 --output_folder, no seed, DIRSIG's default thread count) with a per-run HOME, one render at a time; the first offset rendered twice to establish repeatability; every output compared by sha256; the two images (.img) are the products compared, since each ENVI header carries the written reference time as text (`acquisition time`); cmp.py: the images read as float64 (BIP) and compared value by value.
